papers.title: A Role for the Locus Coeruleus in Hippocampal CA1 Place Cell Reorganization during Spatial Reward Learning.

pipeline_steps.technique: Cre-dependent viral construct strategy for locus coeruleus (LC) indicator/opsin expression and CA1 pyramidal cell indicator expression

parameters.mouse_lines: Th-IRES-Cre (from Kandel lab) and VIP-IRES-Cre x Th-IRES-Cre crosses

pipeline_steps.technique: Bilateral LC viral injection, unilateral dorsal CA1 injection, and hippocampal imaging window/headpost implantation

parameters.lc_coordinates: bilateral, AP -5.45 mm, ML +/-1.28 mm, DV -3.65 mm, 150-300 nL virus
parameters.ca1_coordinates: left hemisphere, AP -2.1/-2.2, ML -1.5/-1.75, DV -1.2/-1.1/-1.0, 50-64 nL per DV site
parameters.window: 3.0 mm diameter, 1.5 mm height imaging window over left dorsal-intermediate hippocampus, stainless-steel or brass headpost
parameters.cannula_construction: 3 mm glass coverslip (Warner 64-0720) adhered to steel cannula (Ziggy's tubes and wires) with Norland optical adhesive
parameters.craniotomy: 3 mm hole; bone, dura, and cortical layers removed with ice-cold cortex buffer irrigation; cannula secured with Vetbond

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon calcium imaging of LC axons and CA1 pyramidal cells with concurrent optogenetic capability

parameters.scanner: 8 kHz resonant scanner (Bruker) with piezo-coupled objective for fast Z displacement
parameters.objective: Nikon 40x NIR water immersion, 0.8 NA, 3.5 mm working distance
parameters.laser: 920 nm (50-100 mW, Coherent Ultra II); 1070 nm (Coherent Fidelity) interlaced for structural red imaging
parameters.detection: GaAsP PMTs (Hamamatsu R3896), preamp (1.4x10^5 dB, Bruker)
parameters.acquisition_params: 1x/1.2x/1.4x digital zoom, 512x512 px; CA1PCs: 2 planes 20-30 um apart at ~8 Hz; axons: 2-5 planes 2 um apart

pipeline_steps.technique: 625 nm LED optogenetic photostimulation of LC axons synchronized to the imaging scan cycle

parameters.gating: triggered by an Arduino board gating the inverse photostimulation signal of the Pockels cell, off briefly during mirror turnaround and piezo direction reversal
parameters.optics: dichroic mirror passing red light in and reflecting green fluorescence to the PMT

pipeline_steps.technique: Goal-oriented learning (GOL) treadmill task with multisensory cues for CA1 imaging

parameters.training: cue-free burlap belt, water deprivation starting 3-4 days post-surgery, reward schedule reduced from 15 locations to 3 rewards per 2 m belt over ~10 days
parameters.imaging_belt: unfamiliar cued belt with multiple fabrics/cues
parameters.ca1_multisensory_cues: constant pinene-scented air, blinking UV LED, constant tone (omitted for LC imaging sessions)
parameters.session_structure: three 10-minute sessions per day, separated by >=45 minutes
parameters.reward_availability: up to 2 s per rewarded location entry

pipeline_steps.technique: Random foraging paradigm with LED stimulation, novel-cue addition, and VIP-interneuron co-stimulation manipulations

parameters.habituation: 3x, 1 day, for maximally stable place fields, then 3x 10-minute sessions/day for three days
parameters.led_schedule: beginning on the third session of the first imaging day, continuing for 5-6 sessions
parameters.performance_metric: proportion of licks in the 35 cm zone preceding the reward zone
parameters.manipulation_variants: LED stimulation inside vs. outside the reward zone; cue addition paired with LED; VIP-interneuron co-stimulation via bReaChES in a Th-IRES-Cre x VIP-Cre cross

pipeline_steps.technique: Post-imaging perfusion, sectioning, and immunohistochemistry to validate LC and CA1 labeling

parameters.fixation: transcardial 0.1 M PBS then 4% PFA, overnight post-fix
parameters.mounting: Aquamount, imaged on a confocal microscope

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: confocal images of immunostained LC and hippocampal sections

pipeline_steps.technique: Calcium imaging preprocessing: motion correction, cell/axon segmentation, cross-session tracking, dF/F calculation, and transient detection

parameters.motion_correction_qc: frames discarded if similarity to the time-averaged image fell below threshold
parameters.segmentation: hand-segmented using an in-lab data visualization server program; same cells/axons tracked across sessions with a unique ID
parameters.df_f_baseline: adapted from Jia et al. 2011, smoothing window t1=3s, baseline window t2=60s
parameters.transient_detection: statistically significant transients detected per previously described method, used for place-field calculations

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, segmented, cross-session-tracked dF/F traces and detected transients

pipeline_steps.technique: Axon-specific signal processing: correlation-based inclusion threshold and single-trace reduction via PCA

parameters.synchrony_check: mean pairwise correlation coefficient per session per ROI, compared to a shuffle distribution built from the same axon across different sessions
parameters.inclusion_threshold: 99th percentile of the shuffle distribution, per animal
parameters.trace_reduction: first principal component of the included axons per session
parameters.detrending_smoothing: linear trend removed over 80 s chunks; Savitzky-Golay filter (21-frame window, polynomial degree 6)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: single reduced, detrended, smoothed population trace per session

pipeline_steps.technique: Place cell classification, place field detection via Gaussian fitting, and reward-zone enrichment analysis

parameters.spatial_information: computed from transients during running bouts >=1s (Skaggs et al. 1993), shuffled 1000 times for a null distribution, place cell if above the 95th percentile
parameters.rate_map: 100 spatial bins, transient count normalized by occupancy, Gaussian-smoothed (sigma=3 bins)
parameters.field_detection: local maxima fit with Gaussian curves; fields discarded if area under the curve was <50% of the largest Gaussian
parameters.enrichment_metric: proportion of place-field centroids in the region from 25 cm before to the end of the reward zone
parameters.transient_properties: frequency, duration (normalized by frame rate), amplitude (peak dF/F), and area under the curve computed per significant transient

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: dF/F traces and detected transients aligned to position
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: place cell classifications, place field locations, and reward-zone enrichment metrics

pipeline_steps.technique: Generalized linear model (ridge regression) predicting LC axon calcium activity from behavioral variables

parameters.predictors: velocity, licking (Gaussian-smoothed, sigma=50 ms), and position (100 non-overlapping binary spatial bins)
parameters.fitting_method: ridge regression to manage predictor collinearity and avoid overfitting
parameters.cross_validation: leave-one-lap-out; regularization penalty optimized via cross-validation on the training set
parameters.fit_quality: coefficient of determination (R2) between predicted and actual calcium activity
parameters.variable_importance: log-likelihood ratio (base-2, bits/sample) between full and reduced (leave-one-variable-out) models, estimated on held-out test data

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: reduced LC population calcium trace and behavioral variable traces
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: fitted GLM weights, cross-validated R2, and per-variable information-gain estimates

pipeline_steps.technique: Linear regression between running velocity and LC calcium signal near the reward zone

parameters.window: -35 cm to 0 cm before the reward
parameters.output_metric: slope of the fitted linear relationship between velocity and the calcium trace

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: LC population calcium trace and velocity trace
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: regression slope quantifying LC-velocity coupling near the reward zone

pipeline_steps.technique: General hypothesis-testing conventions applied across analyses

parameters.non_normal_data: two-tailed paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test or two-tailed unpaired Mann-Whitney U test
parameters.small_sample_rule: non-parametric test used if fewer than 5 data points, regardless of normality test result
parameters.sample_size_determination: no a priori statistical power analysis; sample sizes matched to prior publications
